settings.title: Does it need wifi or a subscription?
settings.content: No. Each story is stored on its own audiobook block, so there is nothing to download, stream or set up, and no subscription. Slot in a book and press play.

settings.title: Does it need charging before we start?
settings.content: No. It arrives ready to play: slot in a story and press play. When it does need a charge, the battery lasts up to 16 hours of listening.

settings.title: What's in a starter pack?
settings.content: The Voxblock player, a protective bumper in the colour you choose, a USB-C charging cable and audiobooks picked for one age group, for less than buying them separately.

settings.title: Which pack should I choose?
settings.content: Start with your child's age. Every pack uses the same player, so you can add more audiobooks any time from our library of 350+.

settings.title: How is it different from a Toniebox or Yoto?
settings.content: Voxblock never needs wifi: each story is stored in its own audiobook block, so there is nothing to download or set up, and nothing for a child to get stuck on. Compare Voxblock and Yoto or Voxblock and Toniebox side by side.

settings.title: What if it isn't right for us?
settings.content: Every player comes with a 100-day money-back guarantee, and UK delivery is free on orders over £25.
